name: AIRDOCTOR AD2000 Air Purifier
description: The original products page filed this air purifier under whole-house water filtration. It is listed under Air Quality here. AIRDOCTOR AD2000 for Small & Medium Rooms and Small Bedrooms. 3 Stage Filtration with Pre-Filter, UltraHEPA, Carbon/VOC
features: IDEAL FOR BEDROOMS, HOME OFFICES & MORE Perfect for bedrooms, nurseries, offices, and more. Rapidly cleans 305 ft2 in 15 minutes & up to 1,220 ft2 in 1 hour delivering consistent air purification where you sleep, work, study, and relax.

HOSPITAL-GRADE ULTRAHEPA FILTRATION AirDoctor AD2000 uses UltraHEPA filtration to capture 99.99% of airborne particles at 0.003 microns, 100x smaller than the HEPA standard. Removes allergens, dust, smoke, mold spores, pet dander, bacteria, and viruses.

PREMIUM ACTIVATED CARBON FILTER FOR GASES & ODORS Reduces toxic gases, odors, pet smells, cooking fumes, gas emissions, wildfire smoke, and VOCs. Made with activated carbon and potassium permanganate to absorb and break down gases and airborne chemicals.

REMOVES COMMON INDOOR AIRBORNE POLLUTANTS 3-stage filtration, backed by rigorous third-party testing, removes dust, allergens, smoke, mold spores, pet dander, pollen, and odors. Includes a Pre-Filter, Premium Activated Carbon filter, and UltraHEPA filter.

AUTO MODE WITH AIRDOCTOR HALO PM2.5 sensors monitor air in real time while the Halo displays color-coded quality levels. Auto Mode adjusts fan speed and activates Boost when needed. Includes timer, filter indicator, and 4 fan speeds.
PROVEN BY SCIENCE, BACKED BY TESTING Supported by independent third-party testing and built on a commitment to transparency, performance, and scientific validation.
QUIET OPERATION Designed for whisper-quiet performance so you can enjoy clean air without disruption. Runs quietly day and night while you sleep, work, or relax.

SUPPORT YOUR WELLNESS ROUTINE Cleaner air supports better sleep, breathing, and overall wellness. AirDoctor removes airborne irritants so you can breathe easier, sleep more comfortably, and wake up feeling refreshed.
